tools.name: find_prescription_discount_prices
tools.description: Find discount prices with a free reusable ClixRx savings card. Retrieves or issues the session card with codes and view/print links. Comparisons cover returned offers only, not market-wide lowest prices. This does not purchase medication, select a pharmacy, or send a message.

tools.name: search_drug
tools.description: Lower-level medication catalog lookup for an explicit current-turn medication request; not for clinical questions or general drug advice. For ordinary price shopping, prefer find_prescription_discount_prices. Returns a bounded, deduplicated medication/form/strength/NDC catalog. NOT medical advice.

tools.name: get_prices
tools.description: Looks up pharmacy price estimates for a verified NDC and retrieves or issues the session’s free reusable savings card. Returns prices, card codes, and view/print links. This does not purchase medication, select a pharmacy, or send a message.

tools.name: get_coupon
tools.description: Look up an existing coupon or reusable savings card using its returned share_token. Never creates a card. For a new reusable card use get_discount_card and retain its cardSessionId. Returns BIN/PCN/Group/Member ID and a share link.

tools.name: get_nearby_pharmacies
tools.description: Find pharmacy locations near a ZIP explicitly requested in the current turn. Returns name, address, chain, and phone; location alone does not prove a ClixRx price offer. Never infer ZIP from profile or memory.

tools.name: get_discount_card
tools.description: Retrieves or issues the session’s free reusable ClixRx savings card, including codes and view/print links. Repeated calls with the same session reuse its card. This does not purchase medication, select a pharmacy, or send a message.

tools.name: get_recommendation
tools.description: Sorts and ranks the pharmacy price offers returned for a medication, ZIP, and quantity, and retrieves or issues the session’s reusable savings card. Returns the top-ranked and backup offers from that price list. Does not purchase medication or send a message.

tools.name: __mcp_health
tools.description: Returns upstream service status, tool count, per-tool latency and uptime; useful for diagnosing an upstream error.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: find_prescription_discount_prices, get_prices, get_discount_card, get_recommendation · Public sink: find_prescription_discount_prices, get_prices, get_coupon, get_discount_card, get_recommendation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: find_prescription_discount_prices, get_prices, get_discount_card, get_recommendation · Public sink: find_prescription_discount_prices, get_prices, get_coupon, get_discount_card, get_recommendation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
